title: Sandbox Control Plane
subtitle: Manage the OpenSandbox server connection, containers and resources
unreachableHint: The OpenSandbox server is not reachable. Make sure it is running and the URL is correct.
enabledButUnreachable: Integration is enabled, but the OpenSandbox server is currently unreachable.
versionHint: The version comes from the SDK; whether the server reports its own version depends on live testing.
confirmDestroy: Destroy this container? This cannot be undone.
confirmDisable: Disable the sandbox integration? All active sessions will be destroyed.
domainHint: The OpenSandbox server host:port, e.g. localhost:8080.
apiKeyHint: Authentication key required by the server (if any).
apiKeySetHint: A key is set; leave blank to keep it unchanged.
guideIntro: The server is unreachable. Follow the steps below to start an OpenSandbox server locally, then return here to set the URL and enable the connection.
aioReqTitle: AIO Sandbox requirement: seccomp must be unconfined
